definitions: A state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.
Pressure or tension exerted on a material object.
Emphasis given to a particular syllable or word in speech, typically by a variation in pitch, loudness, or length.
A force that tends to deform a body.
examples: He's been under a lot of stress lately.
The stress on the bridge was immense.
The stress falls on the first syllable.
The material can withstand high stress.
